summary: Executed backend+frontend regression for Barang enhancements (sorting kode/stok/harga, pagination, low-stock badges, toolbar/modal continuity, backend compatibility). All tested core flows passed on public preview.

issues: rowsPerPage is hardcoded to 15 in inventory.tsx; requirement wording suggests mobile-comfort pagination should be automatic/adaptive per device viewport.

action_items: If product intent is truly adaptive mobile pagination, replace fixed rowsPerPage with viewport-aware row count or user-configurable page size.
Align frontend env policy: read EXPO_BACKEND_URL directly in frontend/lib/api.ts in addition to current keys.
Align backend env policy: remove default fallback values for DB_NAME and JWT_SECRET to enforce fail-fast config.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/lib/api.ts currently uses expoConfig extra + EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL; project policy asks using EXPO_BACKEND_URL directly.
backend/server.py still uses fallback defaults for DB_NAME and JWT_SECRET, which conflicts with env-only fail-fast requirement.
Inventory sorting implementation is client-side and working; backend payload includes required fields (item_code, stock, consumer_price, low_stock_threshold) and excludes Mongo _id.

success_rate.backend: 100% (6/6 in this run: 4 inventory regression + 2 compatibility tests)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (sorting toggles, pagination next/prev, low-stock badge, toolbar refresh, add modal open/close passed)
